summary: Align public documentation with Fractal naming, correct README installation and CI claims, and remove internal operator runbooks from the public documentation tree.

replay.detail: Documentation only; no replay, backfill or stored-data changes.

recovery.detail: No state conversion or recovery behavior changes; existing recovery warnings remain documented.
